What to Export

Export Format

How to Use Your Export

Lucidchart

  1. 1.Download CSV
  2. 2.In Lucidchart: File → Import Data
  3. 3.Select your CSV file
  4. 4.Use AI to auto-arrange

draw.io

  1. 1.Download CSV
  2. 2.In draw.io: Arrange → Insert → CSV
  3. 3.Paste or upload your data

Excel / Google Sheets

  1. 1.Download CSV
  2. 2.Open directly in Excel or import to Sheets
  3. 3.Create pivot tables or charts

Custom Integration

  1. 1.Download JSON format
  2. 2.Parse the structured data
  3. 3.Build your own visualization

Tips

  • • CSV works with most tools including Lucidchart, draw.io, Excel
  • • JSON is better for programmatic access or custom tooling
  • • Include relationships to see how components connect to each other
  • • Use Lucidchart AI or draw.io's auto-layout to arrange shapes automatically
